text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment, please describe the newborn's primary symptoms and any relevant maternal history or pregnancy complications.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the newborn have any visible skin lesions, such as vesicles or pustules, and is she currently feeding well? Please also describe her current level of alertness and any signs of respiratory distress.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you know if the mother had any fever, rash, or joint pain during the first trimester of pregnancy? I need to determine if this is likely Congenital Rubella Syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Rubella IgG and IgM serology
